notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of combat, Workshop Elders triggers, making Basalt Monolith a 0/0 artifact creature until end of turn and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
